purpose: Teach: 本稿/索引/貯蔵/税源/不服/優待/競売/課金

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、業界誌の本稿に何度も寄稿されたぞ
lines.en: Your father contributed to industry journals many times over the years.
lines.style: Measured, steady recollection. Light pride underneath. Voice carries the weight of memory without strain. Open, almost inviting—sharing something he wants understood.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは商品索引にこだわられた
lines.en: Yes. He always paid close attention to how we organized our product catalog.
lines.style: Quiet affirmation. Respectful pause before each phrase. Steady eye contact in the voice. Not defensive—simply confirming what was true about his father's character.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業初期、地下貯蔵庫を確保された
lines.en: In the early days, he made sure we had proper storage—underground, secure.
lines.style: Gentle, almost wondering tone. The voice of someone watching a memory form as he speaks. Slightly slower pace. Small admiration underlying the plainness of the words.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは税源を生かす経営をなさいました
lines.en: Yes. He built the business around understanding tax structure. It was how he thought.
lines.style: Quiet certainty. Each phrase placed carefully, like setting stones. Warm but not sentimental. The tone of a son who understood his father's mind.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社員の不服には真摯にお向き合いだった
lines.en: When staff brought him their grievances, he listened. Really listened. He never turned away from it.
lines.style: Soft, sincere. The voice of someone moved by a memory of integrity. Slight catch of emotion, held steady. Slow enough to honor what he's describing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは優待制度を社員に贈られた
lines.en: Yes. He created a system of benefits for the staff. He thought of them as part of the company's future.
lines.style: Gentle affirmation. No need to explain further—the action speaks. Steady, warm undertone. The voice of someone continuing to understand his father through his choices.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、競売で歴史ある物件を取得されたぞ
lines.en: At auction, he acquired property with real history. Buildings that mattered.
lines.style: Admiration in the slowness. A slight lift on 'history'—respect for what endures. Voice carries the weight of foresight. Almost reverent about the choice itself.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは課金体系も自ら考案された
lines.en: Yes. He even designed the billing structure himself. He wanted to understand every part of it.
lines.style: Final affirmation, weighted with quiet wisdom. Slow, deliberate. Voice carries completion—not of the conversation, but of understanding a life well-lived. Gentle close.
